english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a physically gathered crowd of people.
Use this specifically for a crowd or mass of people rather than a neutral group of animals.
Use this specifically for a large mass or crowd of people, especially when the people are moving together.
Use this for a crowd or group of people blocking or surrounding someone.
Use this instead of 人類 when humanity means a crowd or gathering of people in a particular place.

examples.english: The crowd outside the station is so packed that the road is completely blocked.
examples.traditional: 車站外面嘅人群太逼，搞到條路塞晒。
